name: hukuhaka-memory-audit
description: Audit local memory quality, English wording, and procedural expression through the current host's supported update mechanism.

interface.shortDescription: Review memory quality, language, and procedures.
interface.longDescription: Review retained context for durable value, current evidence, English wording, and suitable procedural pseudocode while preserving meaning. Submit approved changes through the host's supported memory update mechanism. Codex uses its generated-memory update path and a separate size-warning hook.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $memory-audit to review local memory quality and expression, then propose concrete cleanup.
